name: NIAID dataset properties
abstract: The properties NIAID Data Discovery Portal records add to a CDIF dataset, layered on cdifCore by the cdifNIAID profile: NIAID's nde: terms (species, topic category, portal date, ClinicalTrials.gov id, curator, samples, related resources), NIAID's annotations on terms (curation, matched text, and the method that produced them), and cdifniaid: terms for names the portal uses that neither NIAID's schema nor Bioschemas declares, such as the parts of an NIH project number. Requires schema:includedInDataCatalog and a cdifNIAID conformsTo claim. Uses building blocks: bioschemasSample (bioschemasProperties), objectReference (cdifDataType).
